checks.label: Medical/Healthcare Apps Detected
checks.description: Medical/healthcare applications installed - device may handle PHI
checks.remediation: Audit installed medical apps for PHI handling compliance. Remove unauthorized health apps.

checks.label: FDA/Medical Build Properties
checks.description: Medical/regulatory build properties set by manufacturer
checks.remediation: Verify regulatory properties match device certification. Contact manufacturer if properties are missing.

checks.label: HL7/FHIR Ports (2575, 8080)
checks.description: HL7/FHIR API ports - verify TLS and authentication
checks.remediation: Enable TLS on all HL7/FHIR endpoints. Require authentication and restrict access by IP allowlist.

checks.label: DICOM Ports (104, 11112)
checks.description: DICOM imaging ports - verify security configuration
checks.remediation: Enable DICOM TLS and enforce association-level access controls. Restrict ports via firewall rules.

checks.label: Unencrypted PHI Indicators
checks.description: Potential unencrypted PHI found - HIPAA violation risk!
checks.remediation: Encrypt or delete unprotected PHI files immediately. Implement full-disk or file-level encryption.

checks.label: Log Files with PHI Risk
checks.description: Log files may contain PHI - must be encrypted or purged
checks.remediation: Purge log files containing PHI and configure logging to exclude sensitive patient data.

checks.label: External Storage PHI Risk
checks.description: Sensitive files on unencrypted external storage - PHI exposure risk!
checks.remediation: Move sensitive files off external storage to encrypted internal storage. Disable external storage access if not needed.
